fields.description: The region whose machines this Cargo provisions.
fields.label: Region

fields.description: Where this Cargo site is served, e.g. http://10.0.0.5:8000. Recorded when the host enrols.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Registered means the host collected its tokens and is running.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Issue this, then pass it to the host's setup.sh as CENTRAL_BOOTSTRAPPING_TOKEN. It is short-lived and can only be spent once.
fields.label: Enrolment

fields.description: Shared with the host as CENTRAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Cargo signs every report it sends with it, and Central checks the signature against this.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: Minted when the host registers. Central presents it to Cargo for bucket work; the host never sees it until it is called.
fields.label: Cargo Access Token

fields.description: Cargo will set the telemetry base URL once it's ready
fields.label: Telemetry Base URL
